voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.enabled.tooltip: Si buuxda u daar ama u demi softweerka Voxy
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Tirada xadhkaha shaqada (threads) ee uu isticmaali karo kaydka ServiceThreadPool
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Wuxuu isticmaalaa xadhkaha dhismaha ee Sodium si ay uga mid noqdaan kaydka Voxy. Tani waxay yaraysaa ku-gogashada (stuttering) iyo gaabiska (lag) marka si dhakhso ah loo guurayo iyadoo fogaanta muujintu u dambaysao
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Wuxuu furayaa ama xirayaa awoodda Voxy uu qaybaha cusub ee dhulka (chunks) ugu beddelo garaafis fogaan-arag ah (LoDs)
voxy.config.general.rendering.tooltip: Daar ama demi muujinta garaafiska ee Voxy
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Baaxadda ugu sarreysa ee bar-midabeedka (pixels squared) ee shaashadda AABB ka hor intaan loo qaybin LoDs ka yar (Haddii ay ka yaraato, tayada garaafisku waa ay ka sarreysaa)
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Fogaanta muujinta garaafiska ee Voxy marka loo cabbiro qaybaha dhulka (chunks)
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Wuxuu habeeyaa saamaynta dhasha iyo libiqaadka deegaanka
voxy.config.general.ssao_mode.tooltip: Habka loo isticmaalo hooska deegaanka ee shaashadda (Habka 'Auto' wuxuu isku dayaa inuu doorto doonista ugu fiican isagoo yaraynaya saamaynta gaabiska ee kombuyuutarka)
